name: evidence
description: Semantic dictionary defining evidence ontology terms, fields, and relationships.

evidence_object.label: Evidence Object
evidence_object.description: A generic parent term for any observed, collected, or generated evidence used to support facts, findings, risks, or decisions.

log_event.label: Log Event
log_event.description: A timestamped event emitted by an application, infrastructure resource, identity system, security tool, or operating system.

alert.label: Alert
alert.description: A signal raised by a monitoring, security, or detection system indicating a condition that may require attention.

metric.label: Metric
metric.description: A measured numeric observation over time.

trace.label: Trace
trace.description: A recorded execution or request path across services, functions, APIs, or infrastructure components.

audit_record.label: Audit Record
audit_record.description: A record of an administrative, identity, access, configuration, or governance action.

configuration_snapshot.label: Configuration Snapshot
configuration_snapshot.description: A captured state of an infrastructure, identity, application, or security object at a point in time.

scanner_result.label: Scanner Result
scanner_result.description: A result produced by a vulnerability scanner, posture scanner, compliance scanner, or detection engine.

query_result.label: Query Result
query_result.description: A result set produced by a search, query, report, rule, or investigation.

ticket.label: Ticket
ticket.description: A human or workflow record used to track investigation, remediation, approval, or exception handling.

document_evidence.label: Document Evidence
document_evidence.description: A document, file, policy, report, screenshot, attachment, or text artifact used as supporting evidence.

observed.label: Observed
observed.description: Indicates that evidence observed an infrastructure, identity, security, or application object.

emitted_by.label: Emitted By
emitted_by.description: Indicates that evidence was emitted by a specific source object.

collected_by.label: Collected By
collected_by.description: Indicates that evidence was collected by a monitoring, logging, security, or ingestion system.

supports.label: Supports
supports.description: Indicates that evidence supports a finding, claim, fact, risk, impact, remediation, or decision.

contradicts.label: Contradicts
contradicts.description: Indicates that evidence weakens or contradicts a finding, claim, fact, risk, impact, remediation, or decision.

correlates_with.label: Correlates With
correlates_with.description: Indicates that two evidence objects are related by time, identity, source, target, session, request, or another correlation key.

derived_from.label: Derived From
derived_from.description: Indicates that evidence, a finding, or a conclusion was generated from another evidence object.

has_source.label: Has Source
has_source.description: Indicates that evidence has a source system, data stream, index, log group, collector, or integration.

has_subject.label: Has Subject
has_subject.description: Indicates the infrastructure object, identity, application, resource, or security object the evidence is about.

has_actor.label: Has Actor
has_actor.description: Indicates the actor responsible for an action recorded in evidence.

has_target.label: Has Target
has_target.description: Indicates the object acted upon in an evidence record.

occurred_at.label: Occurred At
occurred_at.description: Indicates the specific timestamp or time window when evidence occurred.
